title: Site/app suggestions for retro spaceships, icons and objects?
author: alexmtl
selftext:
Most app that I’ve tried so far (most notably pixellab) do a great job at generating human-like characters and animation in multiple directions. But for my purpose it would be more spaceships (think the ones in starcraft 1 basically). 

Pixellab does a great job at generating one single image but it falls apart when I use the rotate tool to generate multiple orientation.

Then the other part I would need is to generate scifi icons (armor, modules, cpus etc… ) and generic ui icons.

Any good tool out there?
Thanks!

comments.author: mike402
comments.body: Ludo.ai allows you to generate any kind of 2d asset (sprites, gameplay, art, vfx, icons, etc etc), with any art style or perspective. It also has a powerful editing feature to make any kinds of changes to those images (or images you upload)

comments.author: speederaser
comments.body:
I'm also looking for ideas on spaceships. I tried tons of generators and they all seemed so bland (which unfortunately is what happens with AI). 


I ended up looking at existing spaceships for ideas, drawing a shitting paint sketch, then using tile sets, generated or not, to draw in the detail. 


Note, I haven't found a good tileset generator either. I just generate one tile and then put together a set when I'm happy with each tile. 


Still a manual process so far, but interested to see what's new.
